_meta.description: Health, overheal and the speed thresholds the Concord's sensors and turrets read.

health.notes: Both playable characters have 100 base health. Lancer Ivanov can push to 150 with decaying overheal, earned through momentum and through breaking Concord hardware; Ilsa Renn is capped at 100 for the whole prequel.

speed.notes: Concord sensors and turrets read these thresholds. The sprint figure is the movement tuning file's MAX_RUN_SPEED and the wall-kiss ceiling is its WALL_KISS_SPEED_CEILING, so this file cannot drift away from the code.
